title: Container Bookings: goodwill waiver authority, quota and request window by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, the largest single fee row the desk may waive as goodwill, the number of goodwill waivers per customer in the trailing 365 days, and the calendar days after a fee was booked within which a goodwill waiver may be requested.

## What each setting means
- **Waiver authority**: the largest single fee row the desk may waive as goodwill, in USD per fee row; this is the tier's goodwill waiver limit.
- **Waiver quota**: goodwill waivers per customer in the trailing 365 days.
- **Request window**: the calendar days after a fee was booked within which a goodwill waiver may be requested.

## Tier table
| Tier | Waiver authority (USD per fee row) | Waiver quota (per 365 days) | Request window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 150.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 250.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 400.00 | 3 | 45 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 300.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Premium Express | 500.00 | 4 | 60 |

## Points of judgement
**Which tier has the widest goodwill authority?** AHL Premium Express, with 500.00 per fee row, a quota of 4 and a 60-day window.

**Which tiers share a 30-day window?** AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex.
